benchmarks.description: Seconds for Python zlib to compress 64 MiB of generated mixed text at level N, median of five runs (time.perf_counter); no file is written. Compression ratio is not measured: a faster level may compress less.

Seconds to insert 200000 rows into a fresh SQLite file with journal mode N (DELETE, WAL, MEMORY, TRUNCATE), median of five runs, in a temporary folder removed even on failure. Durability differs between modes and is not measured.
